answer: A newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with a bond of 56 POA, forfeited in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 14 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 56 POA on a stranger, so a farm must buy 495 sponsors, each risking real money. A sonnet of doubt is healthy, a harbor of proof is required, and a cipher of patience is the price of a clean panel.
